# Veil 0.16.1

Patch release for all ten Veil, Shield Swap, and Bridge packages, published
under npm's `latest` tag. The functional change is in
`@provablehq/veil-core` and `@provablehq/shield-swap-cli`; the other packages
move in lockstep.

```sh
npm install @provablehq/veil-core@latest @provablehq/shield-swap-cli@latest
```

## Changes

- Add a `floor` inventory distribution. A floor treats the target record
  count as a minimum: the planner counts only records at or above
  `minRecordAmount`, leaves surplus records and sub-minimum dust alone, splits
  the largest record for any shortfall, and never joins. When no set of splits
  can reach the floor it throws `Insufficient available inventory for target
  without joins` before planning rather than consolidating.
- Make `floor` the default distribution. An `InventoryTarget` without
  `distribution` used to mean `preserve`, an exact count reached by joining
  surplus or splitting; it now means `floor`. `autoJoin` asks for `preserve`
  explicitly, since consolidation is an exact single-record layout.
- The Shield Swap CLI inventory policy accepts `"distribution": "floor"` and
  defaults to it. `INVENTORY.md`, the record inventory guide, and the type
  docs describe all three modes.

## Compatibility

The default change is observable. A plan for `{ records: 1 }` with no
distribution now plans nothing when any record already meets the minimum,
where 0.16.0 joined every record into one. Callers that consolidate through
the planner MUST pass `distribution: 'preserve'` to keep the exact-count
behaviour. `preserve` and `balanced` themselves are unchanged, and no type,
option, or export is removed. Peer ranges for `veil-aleo-devnode`,
`veil-aleo-sdk`, and `veil-aleo-wallet-adapter` move to `>=0.16.1 <1.0.0`.

## Validation

The root suite passed 2,750 tests with 316 gated tests skipped across 232
test files. All ten packages build, and the reference dApp typechecks. Packed
peer ranges for `veil-aleo-devnode`, `veil-aleo-sdk`, and
`veil-aleo-wallet-adapter` resolve to `>=0.16.1 <1.0.0`. The feature PR
exercised the floor planner live on testnet through the Shield Swap MCP and
the SDK directly.

Source: [feature PR #215](https://github.com/ProvableHQ/veil/pull/215).
